## Overview

This dataset examines generative AI adoption, cognitive offloading, and perceived intellectual dependence among **2,613 university students**. 

```{r}
#| label: load-data
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

df <- read_csv("data/ai_cognitive_dependence.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Demographics Summary

```{r}
#| label: demographics-table
df |>
  group_by(`Academic Level`, `University Type`) |>
  summarise(
    Respondents = n(),
    `Mean Age` = round(mean(Age, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Female %` = round(100 * mean(Gender == "Female", na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  kable()
```

## The 5 Brain Regions & Cognitive Constructs

The survey measures 25 Likert questions across 5 dimensions, which are mapped to functional brain systems:

| Brain Region | Color | Cognitive Dimension | Exemplar Survey Item |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| **Prefrontal Cortex (PFC)** | `#8b5cf6` (Purple) | Critical Thinking | *Using AI tools reduces my need to think deeply.* |
| **Hippocampus** | `#10b981` (Green) | Academic Decision-Making | *AI tools help me choose research topics or project ideas.* |
| **Anterior Cingulate Cortex (ACC)** | `#f43f5e` (Red) | Trust in AI & Verification | *I rarely verify AI-generated answers before using them.* |
| **Nucleus Accumbens** | `#f59e0b` (Amber) | Cognitive Dependence | *I feel uncomfortable completing academic tasks without AI tools.* |
| **Parietal Cortex** | `#0ea5e9` (Cyan) | AI Usage & Task Execution | *I depend on AI tools to complete academic work faster.* |

## Tidyverse Analysis Pipeline

Here is an example tidyverse pipeline calculating the cognitive dependence index:

```{r}
#| label: sample-pipeline
scale_map <- c(
  "Strongly Disagree" = 1,
  "Disagree" = 2,
  "Neutral" = 3,
  "Agree" = 4,
  "Strongly Agree" = 5
)

# Identify cognitive dependence questions
dep_cols <- names(df)[str_starts(names(df), "Cognitive Dependence")]

# Compute student-level average dependence score
df_scored <- df |>
  mutate(across(all_of(dep_cols), \(x) scale_map[x])) |>
  mutate(dependence_score = rowMeans(across(all_of(dep_cols)), na.rm = TRUE))

df_scored |>
  summarise(
    Mean_Dependence = round(mean(dependence_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD = round(sd(dependence_score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Pct_High_Dependence = round(100 * mean(dependence_score >= 3.5, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  ) |>
  kable()
```
